description:
Nicole Reeyn is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact .

She is a voiceless angel and a member of the Hexenzirkel , also known by her codename "N."
role_summary: Nicole is an off-field Pyro support who provides ATK bonus, Shields, and coordinated attacks. After casting her Elemental Skill , Nicole grants all nearby party members the "Grace of Kenosis" effect, increasing their ATK and protecting them with a "Shield of Blazing Light." When certain conditions are met, "Grace of Kenosis" will upgrade to "Guidance of Theosis," further increasing the ATK bonus. After casting her Elemental Burst , when the active character's attacks hit enemies, Nicole summons an "Arcane Projection" to perform coordinated attacks, dealing AoE DMG of the active character's Elemental Type. This damage is considered to be dealt by that character.

talents.name: Allegoria
talents.description: Normal Attack Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time. Plunging Attack Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

The Shield of Blazing Light's DMG Absorption is based on Nicole's ATK, and it will absorb Pyro DMG at 250% effectiveness.

talents.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
talents.description: As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode. In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them. This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode. talents.description: After completing Witch's Homework : The Role of a Guide...? , Nicole becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters. Hexerei: Secret Rite Increases the DMG dealt by Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections by 300% of Nicole's ATK .

talents.name: Nepsis
talents.description: When you are in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes "Emissarial Guidance" if you have already obtained the current region 's Treasure Compass . Emissarial Guidance: Calls upon nearby Seelie to show the way, triggering an effect similar to the region's Treasure Compass. This effect has a cooldown time of 5 seconds and does not work in Domains , Trounce Domains , and the Spiral Abyss .
